firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to manage user profiles securely and efficiently. The primary collection is `/users/{userId}`, which stores individual user profiles. This path-based ownership model provides excellent security and simplifies rules. This structure facilitates simple, robust, and easily debuggable security rules. There is no denormalized authorization data. No collaborative data is present in this version. Transactions are stored in a subcollection under each user to enforce ownership and for data locality.
